title: A Review of the Challenges with Massive Web-Mined Corpora Used in Large Language Models Pre-Training

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing statistics of data collected in Common Crawl archives to measure the overrepresentation of English-language texts compared to other languages.
Analyzing the geolocation of IP addresses and Top-Level Domains (TLDs) of URLs in the corpus to determine the distribution of hosting countries.
Evaluating the gender and age distribution of content creators on source platforms (e.g., Reddit, Wikipedia) using external demographic reports.
Analyzing the distribution of domains to identify overrepresentation of specific types of websites (e.g., government domains, patent search engines).
Reviewing the impact of aggressive filtering lists (blocklists) on the removal of content related to sexual orientation and minority dialects like African American English.
Measuring the prevalence of hate speech, racial slurs, and sexually explicit content in corpora using text analysis or citing previous quantitative studies.
